Slow Editorial Marquee component displaying high-impact testimonials, featured press (Forbes, NYT, Harvard Business Review, Wall Street Journal), and core themes.
Numbered Manifesto Chapters (e.g., '01 / Purpose Over Velocity', '02 / The Courage to Speak', '03 / Deep Work in a Distracted Era') presented with Swiss-grid bento rhythm.
Dedicated Speaking & Video Gallery page featuring YouTube video modals, keynote topic summaries, audience testimonials, and event booking enquiry triggers.
Interactive Contact & Booking Enquiry form with datepicker, event location, audience size, and instant confirmation toast.
Built-in Admin Enquiry Management Drawer/Page to review, filter, search, and manage submitted speaking & media bookings.
Scalable navigation supporting 3 main core pages (Home, About, Books/Writing) plus Speaking/Videos and Contact/Admin.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts URL provided in typography section in public/index.html or index.css.
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered entrances, scroll-triggered line reveals, and modal animations.
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling or smooth css scroll-behavior is initialized.
All Amazon buy buttons must feature clear Amazon icon/badge branding and open modal or direct link out with custom target='_blank'.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-books-link', data-testid='amazon-buy-button-book-1', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
Use Lucide React icons for crisp editorial iconography (e.g., BookOpen, Play, Calendar, Star, ArrowUpRight, ExternalLink, CheckCircle, Mail, Globe, Shield).
Create realistic seed data for the admin booking table with options to change enquiry status (Pending, Confirmed, Archived) and export or view enquiry details.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
